name: unsaid
description: Catches messages Claude meant for you that went into a hidden thinking block. Before Claude asks you a question or asks you to approve a plan, unsaid checks that the context it wrote for you is visible text; if it is hidden, Claude is asked to send it again before the question appears.

on_hidden_message.title: When a message is hidden
on_hidden_message.description: resend: hold the question once and have Claude send the hidden message as visible text first (the default). show: let the question through and show you the hidden message as a notice.
